words.ex: What happened to the website while I was on holiday?
words.exRo: Ce s-a întâmplat cu site-ul cât am fost în concediu?

words.ex: I was presenting the demo, and at that moment the screen went black.
words.exRo: Prezentam demo-ul și, în acel moment, ecranul s-a înnegrit.

words.ex: I was cooking and talking on the phone at the same time.
words.exRo: Găteam și vorbeam la telefon în același timp.

words.ex: Unfortunately, the train was late and we missed our flight.
words.exRo: Din păcate, trenul a întârziat și am pierdut avionul.

words.ex: Fortunately, I had a copy of all the files on my laptop.
words.exRo: Din fericire, aveam o copie a tuturor fișierelor pe laptop.

words.ex: Someone stole my phone while I was waiting for the bus.
words.exRo: Cineva mi-a furat telefonul în timp ce așteptam autobuzul.

words.ex: The police caught the thief two days later.
words.exRo: Poliția l-a prins pe hoț două zile mai târziu.

words.ex: We were sitting by the fire when the lights went out.
words.exRo: Stăteam lângă foc când s-a stins lumina.

words.ex: Smoke was coming out of the old printer in the office.
words.exRo: Din imprimanta veche din birou ieșea fum.

words.ex: I burnt my hand while I was making pancakes.
words.exRo: M-am ars la mână în timp ce făceam clătite.

words.ex: I dropped my laptop while I was getting off the train.
words.exRo: Am scăpat laptopul pe jos în timp ce coboram din tren.

words.ex: A ball hit the window while we were having lunch.
words.exRo: O minge a lovit geamul în timp ce luam prânzul.

words.ex: The lift was broken, so we walked up to the tenth floor.
words.exRo: Liftul era stricat, așa că am urcat pe jos până la etajul zece.

words.ex: My neighbour was shouting at his dog at six in the morning.
words.exRo: Vecinul meu țipa la câine la șase dimineața.

words.ex: The baby behind us was crying for the whole flight.
words.exRo: Bebelușul din spatele nostru a plâns tot zborul.

words.ex: All my changes disappeared when the program crashed.
words.exRo: Toate modificările mele au dispărut când s-a blocat programul.

words.ex: I slipped on the ice while I was walking to work.
words.exRo: Am alunecat pe gheață în timp ce mergeam la serviciu.

words.ex: It was so foggy that our plane couldn't land.
words.exRo: Era atâta ceață încât avionul nostru n-a putut ateriza.

words.ex: Our server got a virus, so we lost a whole day.
words.exRo: Serverul nostru a luat un virus, așa că am pierdut o zi întreagă.

words.ex: A man came to repair our washing machine yesterday.
words.exRo: Ieri a venit un om să ne repare mașina de spălat.

words.ex: It took us three hours to solve the problem with the database.
words.exRo: Ne-a luat trei ore să rezolvăm problema cu baza de date.

words.ex: We found out about the bug when a client called us.
words.exRo: Am aflat de bug când ne-a sunat un client.

words.ex: I didn't notice the error message because I was talking to my boss.
words.exRo: N-am observat mesajul de eroare pentru că vorbeam cu șeful meu.

words.ex: When we got to the hotel, one of our bags was missing.
words.exRo: Când am ajuns la hotel, ne lipsea una dintre genți.

words.ex: I'm driving now. Can I call you back in ten minutes?
words.exRo: Acum conduc. Te pot suna înapoi în zece minute?

words.ex: We heard a strange noise while we were sleeping.
words.exRo: Am auzit un zgomot ciudat în timp ce dormeam.

words.ex: The whole office network stopped working during the storm.
words.exRo: Toată rețeaua din birou a încetat să funcționeze în timpul furtunii.

words.ex: We moved all the client data to a new server last night.
words.exRo: Azi-noapte am mutat toate datele clienților pe un server nou.

words.ex: When the site went down, I called the hosting company immediately.
words.exRo: Când a picat site-ul, am sunat imediat firma de hosting.

words.ex: I was waiting for you on the corner for twenty minutes!
words.exRo: Te-am așteptat la colț douăzeci de minute!

words.ex: My phone fell on the ground and the screen broke.
words.exRo: Telefonul mi-a căzut pe jos și s-a spart ecranul.

words.ex: We got really wet because we didn't have an umbrella.
words.exRo: Ne-am udat leoarcă pentru că n-aveam umbrelă.

words.ex: After the rain, I changed into some dry clothes.
words.exRo: După ploaie, m-am schimbat în niște haine uscate.

words.ex: The fridge was empty, so we ordered a pizza.
words.exRo: Frigiderul era gol, așa că am comandat o pizza.

words.ex: All the plants on my balcony were dead when we came back.
words.exRo: Toate plantele de pe balcon erau moarte când ne-am întors.

words.ex: Someone knocked on the door while I was in a video call.
words.exRo: Cineva a bătut la ușă în timp ce eram într-un apel video.

words.ex: Ana's hands were shaking before her first presentation to the client.
words.exRo: Anei îi tremurau mâinile înainte de prima prezentare pentru client.

words.ex: We were looking for a solution when Mark had a great idea.
words.exRo: Căutam o soluție când lui Mark i-a venit o idee grozavă.

words.ex: I was holding two coffees, so I couldn't open the door.
words.exRo: Țineam două cafele în mână, așa că n-am putut deschide ușa.

words.ex: The car broke down, so we pushed it to the side of the road.
words.exRo: Mașina s-a stricat, așa că am împins-o pe marginea drumului.

words.ex: My little son pulled the cat's tail, and it scratched him.
words.exRo: Fiul meu cel mic a tras pisica de coadă, iar ea l-a zgâriat.

words.ex: After the storm, the fishermen were wet and cold, but alive.
words.exRo: După furtună, pescarii erau uzi și înghețați, dar în viață.

words.ex: I killed three mosquitoes while I was trying to sleep.
words.exRo: Am omorât trei țânțari în timp ce încercam să dorm.
